description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineIpcMock' for the 'IMediaPipelineIpc' interface, used for unit testing media pipeline IPC interactions in the Rialto client component. It includes mock method declarations for various media control functions.

classes.name: MediaPipelineIpcMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaPipelineIpc interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Mocks attaching a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Mocks removing a media source by ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Mocks checking if all sources are attached.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Mocks loading media with specified type, MIME type, and URL.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Mocks setting the video window position and size.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Mocks checking if media data is available.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current playback position.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mocks muting or unmuting the audio.
